ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (8) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The passage is from Dostoevsky's «Записки из Мертвого дома» (Zapiski iz Myortvogo doma), given under its usual English title 'Notes from the House of the Dead'. Prison terms are kept plain: «особое отделение» (osoboye otdeleniye, 'the special section'), «ладонка» (ladonka, a small amulet bag worn with the cross, here 'amulet bag'), «фельдшер» (fel'dsher, 'doctor's assistant'), «чешуя» (cheshuya, 'scales', the helmet's chin scales); «кандалы» (kandaly) are 'shackles' throughout, and «Тоже ведь мать была!» keeps its dialogue dash.
